landmarks.what: raw-byte project.toml patcher: indexDoc classifies lines/spans (headers·keys·multi-line values·CRLF), apply splices set/delete/append-elem/delete-elem ops re-indexing per op, refuses inline tables by line; renderValue via encodeFresh

diff(old·new *Project) walks encoder-canonical generic trees into per-leaf set/delete ops·per-element array-of-tables ops (positional edit when lengths match, deep-equal match + delete/append otherwise); unclassifiable shape errors by path; encodeCanonical routes through encodeFresh

Save is the sole project.toml writer: existing file → Load·diff·apply·canonical-verify·atomic temp+fsync+rename (mode kept, read-only refused, zero ops = no write); absent path → encodeFresh, the package's single encoder call site

in-process cobra matrix (state set version·project set scalar/array/absent-key/sub-table/--unset·issue enable/disable·test lane add/edit/remove·stack apply) asserts exact changed-line sets and that comments + unmodeled keys survive every writer; real project.toml bump = one-line diff
